QuestInfo.name: Tina's Proposition
QuestInfo.0: Help #bTina#k with her request, then ask her to help with Blake's debut.
QuestInfo.1: You need key chains for a grand opening promotion! Collect key chains and dolls from the Doll Claw game on the #r3rd-4th Floors of Kerning Square#k.
QuestInfo.2: You were able to get a makeup artist for the job. Deliver the good news to #bLana#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 8,150\nCan proceed to Makeup Artist, Booked! quest\n

0.0: #b#h0##k. You wanted me to help with Blake's makeup, right? Will you help me with a few things first?

yes.0: Great! I'd really like to give out some small gifts to get people into my new shop! I think some key chains and dolls would be perfect! Maybe I'll need #b20 Yeti Key chains, 20 Jr. Pepe Key chains, and 20 Orange Mushroom Dolls#k? The Doll Claw Games on the #r3rd-4th floors of Kerning Square#k would be your best bet.

no.0: Did you talk to me just to tell me you refuse to help? Strange person...

1.0: Have you brought all the things I've asked for? Let me see them.

yes.0: Perfect. As promised, I will do Blake's makeup. Please let Lana, the CEO of Big Hit Records, know. Oh, and could you also thank her for the gig?

item.0: Please bring me #b20 Yeti Keychains, 20 Jr. Pepe Keychains, and 20 Orange Mushroom Dolls#k. You can find a lot of #rDoll Claw Games#k on the 3rd-4th floors of Kerning Square.\r\n
